summary: 15 features and 5 fixes across HagiCode-org/hagicode-core, HagiCode-org/web.
bodyHtml:
Features

HagiCode-org/hagicode-core

  • session: answer interactive questions over gRPC (6f53a71)
  • antigravity: deliver chat images and route Magpie models (ab3d456)
  • conversation-resource-usage: broadcast aggregate resource snapshots (a34eb07)
  • antigravity: add Antigravity CLI provider and session support (a202477)

HagiCode-org/web

  • magpie: enable Antigravity catalog selection and settings (cf45526)
  • statusbar: show live conversation resource usage trends (ec17aa9)
  • conversation: render historical tool status tallies (926c384)
  • hero: add Antigravity setup and capability details (652b00f)
  • web: convert tier rating emblems from WebP to AVIF (38bb6a8)
  • antigravity: add Antigravity CLI support across clients (3a35637)
  • process-tree: show a live glance and responsive rows (6bbf67e)
  • proposal-memory: cap setup history per project by recency (3be762f)
  • token-monitor: build a usage cockpit for the mobile dashboard (e4795c3)
  • token-report: replace daily usage table with column chart (6393b91)
  • input: adapt remote controls to narrow composer layouts (e1aceee)

Fixes

HagiCode-org/hagicode-core

  • process-tree: retain residual roots and report platform support (b16aab3)

HagiCode-org/web

  • ui: float remote input controls over text fields (c2a5b2c)
  • web: scope monitoring channels to enabled CLI settings (8ec36d8)
  • conversation: collapse changed files by default in drawers (3066db2)
  • scope-tabs: keep project scope lists scrollable in drawers (f32ede9)
